narr: Thunderstorms moved west across western Cochise, Pima and Santa Cruz counties during the afternoon and early evening. Lightning at Agua Caliente Park.
ev: Heavy rain of an inch in one hour caused flash flooding near Agua Caliente Park and the closure of Soldier Trail Rd. near Roger Rd.
lsr: PIMA COUNTY SHERIFF REPORTED A ROAD CLOSURE DUE TO FLOODING AT THE INTERSECTION OF ROGER ROAD AND SOLDIER TRAIL.
